batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c CH Morris b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b STR Binny

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b TG Southee

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c CJ Anderson b S Gopal

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b R Vinay Kumar

balls.text: Royals concede a needless extra run last ball, Suchith missed a full delivery outside off, they went for the bye, keeper lobbed the ball to Morris, who missed at the non-striker's end and gave away an overthrow
makes some room outside leg, Morris follows him with a yorker, it is jabbed down the ground
middle stump is pegged back as Anderson misses a swipe, the fullish ball brushes the thigh pad and crashes into the stump
full toss, helpful full toss, sent flying over the long on boundary, fifty for Anderson in 37 balls
Anderson has sliced this full delivery high over backward point and it runs into the boundary
low full toss squeezed straight down the ground and they push for the second
could have been another flicked six but Pollard could not get enough distance on this full one and deep midwicket tumbles forward to take it
full delivery, Pollard cannot connect for once and it goes through to the keeper
six more, Royals leaking runs all around the ground, this is a violent swing that deposits the shortish ball over deep square leg
mid off is up, this is a full toss outside off, and Pollard reaches it to mow it down the ground
backs away to a shortish ball and underedges the pull, there is no one at fine leg, and this is four more
shot, Pollard picks this full ball from Southee and flicks it in the air, that falls right on to the deep midwicket rope
Pollard moves to 50 off 28 with a hit to the sweeper
down the track and cracks it hard, Rahane saves the boundary with sharp work to his left at deep midwicket, a better throw would have had Anderson though
short googly, Anderson winds up but toe ends the widish one towards point
quicker one on the stumps, he backs away and heaves it through midwicket
slams a full toss straight over the bowler
that kept long on interested all the way, and cleared him safely, Pollard reaching for a flighted ball and connecting
cannot get the timing right as he looks to go over long on, and it rolls to the man after bouncing a few times, Pollard makes it just in time for the second
slower length ball, Pollard cannot connect this time as he tries to go square
full toss, Pollard makes some room, and slams it one bounce over long off boundary, that fell just inside
short ball, Pollard goes to the leg side, the ball follows him, and gets big on him
over deep extra cover now and into the stands, stays in the crease to a fuller one, and powers it over the boundary
short and not much lift from Faulkner, Pollard blasts it to the deep midwicket boundary with a flat hit
slow bouncer, Anderson has not been particularly comfortable with the pull tonight, is beaten again as he swivels
full across Pollard, guided to sweeper cover
a low full toss, Pollard turns it through midwicket, and this has gone right in the gap, beating deep midwicket and long on
much fuller from Southee on middle, Anderson cannot get underneath, hits it along the ground to long off
slower ball, Anderson swings again, this is not off the middle, but powerful enough to beat long on to his right
and even Southee goes for six first ball on return, length ball, right in Anderson's swinging zone, disappears into the crowd beyond long on
a wide full toss, Anderson throws his bat at it, toe ends it to sweeper cover

Anderson has mishit a fuller delivery to long off some way inside the boundary, just could not get any distance on it, but Kulkarni does not seem to have any part of the boot behind the crease, Anderson was walking off, but he comes back to face the free hit
good length ball rolls square off the pad
that'll go, short again, and Pollard opens up, goes to the leg side and clobbers it past deep midwicket
slower bouncer, Pollard tries to generate power on the pull, hits it to midwicket
cutter across Anderson on the stumps, he adjusts and taps it to point
short of a length ball turned to fine leg
Faulkner goes for six more last ball of the over, Anderson gets under a length ball and firmly drives it over the wide long off boundary
slower one angled in to Anderson, who can only pat it back
a leading edge as he comes out and tries to tuck a back of a length ball to leg, balloons wide of mid off
beaten this time as Pollard pushes at a length ball leaving him on the angle
Faulkner bangs it in short now, Pollard lets it go past his bat, then swishes in the air as it nears the keeper
Faulkner is welcomed back with a flicked six over deep midwicket, was a good length ball on middle, and Pollard sent it soaring over the man in the deep with a wristy flourish
shortish, Anderson rides the bounce and knocks it down to backward point
beaten, it was slanted across him on a good length, he went for a big drive in vain
clean and straight, Morris pitches it full and slow, Anderson sets himself up and clobbers it in the air
Samson saves some runs with a dive to his left to half stop an underedge of a heave from Pollard to a wide ball
Pollard walks down the track now, and lifts an angled length ball over wide mid on
that is a snorter, arrives at Pollard's chest, he fends it on to the pitch awkwardly
full and down the leg side, Tambe is cross with himself as Anderson puts it away with a gentle sweep
slants a fuller one across Anderson, who slams it to extra cover
charges out now and heaves, gets a thick inside edge to deep midwicket
tries to jump out again, stops, tries to cut, is beaten now
Pollard leaves the crease, tries to defend, is hit on the pad
fullish on the pad, turned to deep square leg
slanted in fullish and Pollard is hit on the pad as he misses the flick, was headed down leg
width again on this length ball and Anderson smears it to the sweeper
fine reply from Anderson as he smashes an over pitched ball, cannot place it wide of mid off though
and another one gets big and jags back in to Anderson, who takes it on the bat handle this time as he gets the glove out of the way
cramped for room completely this time, tried to chop a short of a length ball but is hit on the left wrist as it comes in
Anderson hurried on a pull again, and this time under edges it on the bounce to lone slip
shout for leg before as Pollard presses forward, this came in instead of turning away, umpire shakes his head

got him, good stuff from Tambe, Chand has yorked himself, it was tossed up again, Chand stepped out without much conviction, and the ball dipped and slid quickly under his bat to take out middle stump
fullish, middle and leg line, nudged in front of square, there is again space to take two
punched down to long off again
down the track to hammer it down to long off
tossed up on leg stump, turned square for a couple
that shortish ball came in, Anderson tried to swat it over the leg side, but could not connect again, that bounced over the stumps
tries to cut a back of a length ball that zips through and is beaten
moves forward to drive now, but hits it straight to the bowler
slightly fuller, closer to off too, he lets it go past
good length skidding through outside off, left alone
back of a length on the pads, dribbles away on the leg side
comes in with the angle from round the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
pitched up ball pushed to long off with a big forward stride
fuller one driven along the ground to long off
tossed up, defended off the front foot
falls over as he bends to sweep one angled in fuller, hit the thigh pad, could have been some glove before that, else that was close
a straighter one on a good length, beats him as he was expecting some turn
good length, on middle and off, he defends it close to the pitch on off and tries to run, but bowler is on to it
overpitched, slanted across, Anderson reaches the line with a forward stride and dispatches it through extra cover
angles it across left-hander Anderson, who leaves it alone
and now he strikes, he kept moving the line across Rohit, this one was floated up outside off, moved away a tad, Rohit pushed at it away from the body, and the lone slip was in business
right on off stump off a good length now, quite disciplined from Binny, Rohit defends it back to the bowler
angled in towards middle and leg, good length, patted down the track
that was quick and bouncing, came in a bit too, but Chand has cut this very hard and fine, giving no chance to third man
angled in this time after all those away swingers, pushed straight to mid on
full, wide and swinging away big, Chand on the knee for a bigger drive, but cannot connect
pitched up and swinging away, Chand plays it softly from the crease
Chand tries to cut one moving away from short of a length, and is beaten by some extra bounce
hint of away shape from a good length, Rohit shoulders arms
angled in from wide of the crease, Rohit defends from around the line of off
Kulkarni strikes with a slower one, Parthiv tried to make some room and loft it over extra cover, but badly mishit it, and it is an easy catch at mid off
Kulkarni keeps producing these bottom edges, this almost took leg stump as Chand tried to force one off the back foot, did not have the room
fuller length and he reaches forward to drive, straight to cover
moves away from a good length, Chand lunges on to the front foot but lets it go eventually
shout for leg before as Parthiv is beaten by a length ball as he moves across, but turned down, could have pitched outside leg
stays in the crease as this length ball comes in to him, and succeeds in turning it past short fine leg
Parthiv gets width and cuts hard, but straight to cover on the bounce, missed out here

back of a length, some away shape, Finch pats it in front of mid off and goes for the single, underarm throw misses, Finch has pulled up after completing that run, and is down on the ground straight away in pain in the left leg
skips down the track and tries to go down the ground, but finds himself too close to the pitch, and cannot beat the bowler
Binny starts shortish on the pad, but Parthiv cannot time the pull and deep square is able to cut it off
a straightish good length ball outside off, Finch carefully lets it go
just back of a length, not much room outside off, Finch tries to force it away, gets a thick inside edge to midwicket
had the width this time but is wary after that last ball, and his weak punch finds short extra cover
lovely delivery, hits back of a length, bounces and moves away late past the outside edge, FInch left prodding from the crease
good length on the pads, tucked away to deep square
lucky boundary for Parthiv, flashes a cut without much room, and a bottom edge runs past the stumps, and the keeper
overdoes the angle now and Finch tucks him behind square, well away from the man at deep square leg
he's been taking it away, but this one has swung back in a long way, Finch was leaning across, and manages to inside edge it on to his pad
holds the line some way outside off, Finch does not go for it
fuller this time, moving in a bit, Parthiv gets it through midwicket off the inner part of the bat, and it goes far enough for him to come back for the third
much better line, right on off stump, good length, Parthiv has no room and pats it down the track
Morris starts on the left-hander's pads and Parthiv is not missing out, he whips it fine past the man in the ring
had a look at it, it was a gentle good length ball outside off, some bounce on it, he lets it go in the end
this comes in a tad from outside off stump, left alone
Southee angles it in from wide of the crease, gets it to curl away late, but Finch has hit the gap between cover and point with the drive, was in the air for a while, but out of reach
straightens it on the left-hander's off stump, and Parthiv is away with a soft push to covers
much wider outswinger, Finch goes after it, a thick edge zooms down flat to third man, on the bounce
gentle outswinger on a good length from the New Zealander, not too far outside off, Finch lets it be

wrong 'un, Faulkner hits it to the covers off the back foot, they go for the run, there is an appeal for a run-out at the bowler's end, really tight this one, third umpire decides that Faulkner has just made it as the bail comes off
another one, makes slight room, bends the legs a bit, arches back a bit, and crashes another drive between extra cover and mid off
cannot get this full delivery past the bowler, who throws it back to the keeper and makes Smith hurry back into his crease
drives a length ball on the up, but straight to mid off
works a slower short of a length ball behind square leg, takes the Orange Cap too with this couple
outstanding shot, down the track, moving inside the line, and dismissing a length ball between extra cover and mid off with total authority
slower length ball nudged to square leg

Smith all but seals it with another of his ridiculously well-timed checked pick-up shots over midwicket, that is some way into the crowd, moves across early, stands on off, and takes it from around middle and leg
connects with this full toss but not well enough to deny Pollard running to his right from long on
misses out and is beaten as he tries to drive this full toss off the back foot
around the blockhole outside off, squeezed to long off
fullish on middle, worked through midwicket, they press for the second, make it
pitched up and skidding on middle, Smith cannot get under that and drives it to long off
slowish length ball on middle and leg, Smith calmly pushes it to long on, keeps strike
foxed by the slower one this time, was winding up but was left prodding outside off at the change of pace
four more, comes off a thick outside edge to the third man boundary as Smith throws the bat at a full one
imperious drive past extra cover to a length ball, sweeper cannot prevent the second
exquisite from Smith, he purrs to his maiden IPL fifty, feet wide apart, bending to a yorker outside off and guiding it past backward point
Smith starts the over with a quality checked pick-up over midwicket, it was quite full but he leaned back a bit to get under it, deep midwicket is vacant
concedes only a single off the free hit, Smith cannot beat extra cover as he moves across and pushes a full one, direct hit would have been tight at non-striker's end
uh oh, that has gone horribly wrong for Suyal, it is a very high delivery that almost goes on the full to the keeper wide outside off
checks his lofted shot as Suyal gets it really full again, long on reaches it on the bounce, and Suyal has bowled a no-ball again
bowls it full, wide and quick, Smith tries to reach it, cannot connect again, wants a wide but this isn;t
walks across outside off, Suyal bowls it very full and gets it to swing away a bit, Smith is in an awkward position and beaten
that'll help Royals, he gets a thick edge as he drives from the crease, the ball flies to the fine third man rope
shortish, onto the pad, turned behind square
gets across to a shortish ball and whips it behind square, fielder saves the boundary with a dive
gets a low full toss first up, and carefully pats it to midwicket

Malinga strikes, uproots leg and middle stumps, Hooda walked across his stumps sensing that Malinga would bowl full and into the pads, he did, and Hooda missed, the replays are tight for the front-foot no-ball check, but Malinga seems to be just fine
opens the face on a very full one outside off, away to the sweeper
stays back to a fuller one and squeezes it calmly through the covers
slants it full and down leg this time
that has gone through Smith, and somehow missed the stumps, he went for a big drive and the ball zipped past the outside edge, wasn't far from off
starts with a yorker just outside off, Smith guides it behind point for two
six more, this stayed in the air longer, Hooda advancing out again, getting under the ball and going over long off now
Hooda launches it big over deep midwicket, leaves the crease immediately, takes it off middle and carts it high
shortish googly, Smith cannot beat deep midwicket on the pull once again
almost popped it back to the bowler, was just out of his reach in the end to his right
down the track, takes it on the full and whips it powerfully, but not wide enough of deep midwicket
Rahane has picked out long off, skipped out and went with the spin, but was not too close to the pitch and did not get the distance
gets the boundary off the last ball, leaves the crease, gets close to the pitch and drives it hard past the bowler
Rahane down the track, but is not to the pitch and swats it to long on for one
slogged down to deep midwicket, did not get hold of it
Smith tries to make room and go off side but misses a yorker length ball just outside off, there is a stumping appeal but he is fine
hits a tossed up ball along the ground to long on
sweeps straight to Malinga at short fine leg
almost picks it straight to deep backward square leg, this was pushed through much quicker, to the fielder on the bounce
did him in the flight as he darted down the track, had to stop and push it on the off side
straightens and skids on towards middle, is pulled to deep square
short and headed down the pads, helped behind square, and a dive is needed at fine leg from Vinay
dropped, was the googly as he pulled it in the air, Chand dived forward, but it burst out of his hands, difficult chance
went back to a fullish ball and stabbed it back to the bowler
almost yorked himself as he jumped out, but was able to squeeze it square in the end, there is a misfield at deep point
on the back foot to a pitched up ball, whips it to long on
skips out and goes over extra cover now, sweeper does well to run to his right and stop it
was done in the flight, appeared to come out, stopped and got a thick edge fine, pulled back at third man boundary by Suyal
down the track and heaves, but along the ground to long on, came off the inner part of the bat
stays back to a tossed up ball and cuts to the sweeper
another wide one, Smith cannot connect again
this is way outside off stump, almost a foot outside the marker, but not called a wide, weird
stands outside off stump now and punches it straight to point
walks across and tries to pull, but this is angled in, cramping him for room, and also not short, but he picks up two still to deep midwicket
flat-bats a good length ball down to long off
short and wide, hit straight to the man at sweeper cover, Smith has missed out a few times against Anderson now
comes down the track and whips it hard, but straight to deep midwicket
goes back to one slanted in and nudges it to deep square
short again, and this time Rahane is not missing out, the pull races into the gap between deep midwicket and long on
nicely flighted and dipping again, Rahane leans forward and pushes it to off
shortish, Rahane quick to rock back but the pull is not hit well enough to beat long on running across
tossed up nicely around off stump, defended square
comes in from back of a length, is tucked to fine leg
he's gone over extra cover, this sat up from back of a length, and Rahane intentionally went over the ring
cut hard but a dive at backward point takes pace off it, third man fields
wide again, this time he connects well enough to take two wide of the sweeper
quite wide but stops on Smith and he toe ends it close to the pitch
had width on a length ball but could not punch it past extra cover
straightens from a length, he rocks back to punch to sweeper cover
down the track, takes it on the full and whips it behind square for two
nudged off the pad to backward square leg
stays back to a flighted one, lets it spin away, and cuts it for a single
goes on the back foot and hits this flatter one to the sweeper
tosses it up, Smith leaves the crease and pushes to long off
tries to play a controlled pull but ends up top edging over square leg, safely
whipped from way outside off to wide mid on
sets himself up for a not so short delivery, cranks up and pulls hard through midwicket
awkward from Smith as he tries to force to leg one that jags away from him, beaten
short of a good length, guided down to third man
Malinga starts with a length ball around middle and is tucked in front of square
comes in a bit from a good length, is defended
moves across, takes this length ball off middle and leg and works it quite fine
drags a pull from well outside off to deep midwicket
Samson has had one leading edge too many, wanted to work a length ball off the pad, ended up hitting it high and limply to mid off
Samson lifts this short of a length ball on the up, has not got hold of it too well, but has cleared mid on
that was close, Samson leaned forward to play this length ball which came in a bit and took the inside edge on to pad and to the keeper
eases this pitched up ball straight down the ground, but not much power or timing on this one
pulls, and hits the gap between midwicket and mid on, just past the latter in the end
turns a back of a length ball in front of square, Anderson misfields but after much confusion, they settle for one
tries to pull but it was not quite short and he hits it into the ground, away to wide mid on
yorker, around off, jabbed to point
leans forward and pushes on the up to cover, the throw misses at the non-striker's, backing up fielder fails to gather it cleanly and a run is on
Vinay giving nothing away, Rahane pats away another good length ball just outside off
leading edge flies down to third man as Samson leaves the crease again but this one pitched slightly shorter and jagged away
length ball on middle, tucked behind square
walks down the track and nudges a length ball to midwicket
nice, swinging away from a good length, and Samson beaten as he follows it
Vinay spot on again, with a good length ball just outside off, defended
shout from the bowler, got batsman in a tangle as he walked out and failed to work this away square
worked behind square leg for a single
pushed off the front foot to mid on
full outside off, Samson slices it hard over the covers and the chase from the fielder is in vain
pitched up and it is a solid drive that is cut off by mid on, and this is also a big front-foot no-ball
width outside off on this shortish ball, and Samson firmly guides it into the gap between cover and point
short of a good length, turned to deep backward square
good over from Vinay, ends with some away shape on a good length close to off, is guided to point
tight line again, good length just outside off, left alone
back of a length, no room, turned behind square leg for one
has a go at the cut, but this comes in a bit from back of a length, and he finds cover
straightish good length ball outside off, Rahane lets it go
outswinger first ball, Rahane comes forward to defend
